events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Oakland Raiders

headlines.description: Derek Carr threw a 2-yard touchdown pass to Michael Crabtree on the final play after the game was extended by two straight penalties and the Oakland Raiders snapped a four-game losing streak with a 31-30 victory over the Kansas City Chiefs on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raiders score on final play to beat Chiefs 31-30

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: Rookie cornerback Tre'Davious White forced and recovered a fumble to set up Stephen Hauschka's 30-yard field goal with 14 seconds remaining, and the Buffalo Bills beat the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 30-27 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills rally to beat Bucs 30-27 on late Hauschka field goal

headlines.description: Rookie safety Eddie Jackson became the first NFL player to score multiple defensive touchdowns of 75 yards or more in a game, leading the Chicago Bears to a 17-3 victory over the Carolina Panthers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jackson's 2 defensive TDs lead Bears past Panthers 17-3

headlines.description: Ryan Succop's fourth field goal -- a 47-yarder with 1:55 left in overtime -- extended his NFL record for makes inside 50 yards to 55 straight and sent the Tennessee Titans to an ugly 12-9 win on Sunday over the winless Cleveland Browns.
headlines.shortLinkText: Succop's kick in OT gives Titans ugly 12-9 win over Browns

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Drew Brees threw for a touchdown and ran for another, Mark Ingram rushed for a score and the New Orleans Saints overcame several mistakes to beat the Green Bay Packers 26-17 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Saints recover late to topple Packers 26-17

headlines.description: Blake Bortles threw for a season-high 330 yards and one touchdown, and T.J. Yeldon scored on a 58-yard run, leading the Jacksonville Jaguars past the Indianapolis Colts 27-0 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bortles, Jaguars' D sacks Colts 27-0 to stay atop division

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: The Los Angeles Rams will finally have something to celebrate on their long flight home.
headlines.shortLinkText: Goff leads Rams to shutout with Cardinals' Palmer injured

events.name: New York Jets at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: Matt Moore replaced an injured Jay Cutler and threw two touchdown passes in the final 12 minutes, and the Miami Dolphins pulled off another comeback win by erasing a 14-point fourth-quarter deficit to beat the New York Jets 31-28 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Moore leads Dolphins to 31-28 comeback win over Jets

headlines.description: Latavius Murray rushed for 113 yards and a touchdown and Kai Forbath kicked six field goals to lift the Minnesota Vikings to a 24-16 victory over the Baltimore Ravens on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Murray, Vikings defense plow through Ravens, 24-16

headlines.description: Ezekiel Elliott gained 219 yards from scrimmage and tied a career high with three touchdowns just days after a legal reprieve put his suspension on hold and the Dallas Cowboys beat the winless San Francisco 49ers 40-10 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Elliott's 3 TDs, 219 yards lead Cowboys past 49ers 40-10

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at New York Giants

headlines.description: Russell Wilson threw three second-half touchdown passes, and the Seattle Seahawks limited the New York Giants' receiver depleted offense to 177 yards in a 24-7 win on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson throws 2 second-half TDs, Seattle D dominates

headlines.description: Ben Roethlisberger threw for 224 yards and two touchdowns, Le'Veon Bell added 192 total yards and Pittsburgh's defense dominated the Cincinnati Bengals in the second half of a 29-14 victory on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers shut down Bengals to pull away for 29-14 win

events.name: Denver Broncos at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: Travis Benjamin returned a first-quarter punt 65 yards for a touchdown and caught a 42-yard TD pass in the fourth, and the Los Angeles Chargers played a dominant defensive game in the first home victory of their relocation season, 21-0 over the Broncos.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chargers send Broncos to 1st shutout loss in 25 years, 21-0

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw two touchdown passes and the New England Patriots toyed with the Atlanta Falcons -- sound familiar? -- 23-7 in a fog-filled Super Bowl rematch Sunday night that wasn't particularly super.
headlines.shortLinkText: Super Mismatch: Patriots continue mastery of Falcons 23-7

headlines.description: Carson Wentz tossed four touchdown passes, and the Philadelphia Eagles overcame losing nine-time Pro Bowl left tackle Jason Peters in a 34-24 win over the Washington Redskins on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wentz tosses 4 TDs, Eagles beat Redskins 34-24
